title.zh: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday
title.en: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday

current_state.zh: The House Financial Services Committee will mark up the American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA), which would establish a federal Bitcoin reserve in statute, but the bill has only one Democratic cosponsor who does not sit on the committee.
current_state.en: The House Financial Services Committee will mark up the American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA), which would establish a federal Bitcoin reserve in statute, but the bill has only one Democratic cosponsor who does not sit on the committee.
